## Purpose of this Recipe

The 3x2pt data vector consists of three sets of angular power spectra: cosmic shear (source-source), galaxy-galaxy lensing (source-lens), and galaxy clustering (lens-lens).
Below, the [[likelihood|TwoPoint]] objects for these spectra are built for the LSST Y1 tomographic bins, their theory vectors are computed at the default parameter values, and the spectra are plotted.
The bin pairs and multipoles are generated from metadata, so no SACC file is read.
A user running this notebook needs Firecrown, installed as described in the [installation quickstart](https://firecrown.readthedocs.io/en/latest/install_quick.html), and matplotlib.

For the concepts used here, see the tutorials on [two-point generators](../two_point_generators.qmd), [bin pair selectors](../two_point_bin_selectors.qmd), and [factory basics](../two_point_factory_basics.qmd).

## Tomographic Bins and Bin Pairs

The LSST Y1 lens and source bin collections, [[generators|LSST_Y1_LENS_HARMONIC_BIN_COLLECTION]] and [[generators|LSST_Y1_SOURCE_HARMONIC_BIN_COLLECTION]], each generate five tomographic bins.
The selector [[metadata_types|ThreeTwoBinPairSelector]] with `lens_dist=0` keeps three groups of bin pairs: all 15 source-source pairs, the 5 lens auto-correlations, and the 10 source-lens pairs whose source bin index is larger than the lens bin index.
Keeping only the lens auto-correlations follows the LSST DESC Science Requirements Document ([arXiv:1809.01669](https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.01669), Appendices D1.1 and D2.1).

```{python}
from collections import Counter

import numpy as np

from firecrown.generators import (
    LSST_Y1_LENS_HARMONIC_BIN_COLLECTION,
    LSST_Y1_SOURCE_HARMONIC_BIN_COLLECTION,
)
from firecrown.metadata_functions import make_binned_two_point_filtered
from firecrown.metadata_types import ThreeTwoBinPairSelector, TwoPointHarmonic

lens_bins = LSST_Y1_LENS_HARMONIC_BIN_COLLECTION.generate()
source_bins = LSST_Y1_SOURCE_HARMONIC_BIN_COLLECTION.generate()

selector = ThreeTwoBinPairSelector(lens_dist=0)
bin_pairs = make_binned_two_point_filtered(lens_bins + source_bins, selector)
```

Each bin pair, together with the multipoles at which the spectrum is computed, defines one [[metadata_types|TwoPointHarmonic]] metadata object.
The multipoles below are 40 logarithmically spaced values between 20 and 2000, truncated to integers.

```{python}
ells = np.unique(np.geomspace(20, 2000, 40).astype(int))
metadata = [TwoPointHarmonic(XY=xy, ells=ells) for xy in bin_pairs]

Counter(md.get_sacc_name() for md in metadata)
```

## Building the TwoPoint Objects

A [[likelihood|TwoPointFactory]] converts each metadata object into a [[likelihood|TwoPoint]] object.
The factory below uses the default weak lensing and number counts sources, without systematics.

```{python}
from firecrown.likelihood import TwoPointFactory
from firecrown.utils import base_model_from_yaml

factory_yaml = """
correlation_space: harmonic
weak_lensing_factories:
  - type_source: default
    per_bin_systematics: []
    global_systematics: []
number_counts_factories:
  - type_source: default
    per_bin_systematics: []
    global_systematics: []
"""

factory = base_model_from_yaml(TwoPointFactory, factory_yaml)
two_points = factory.from_metadata(metadata)
```

## Computing the Theory Vectors

The function [[updatable|get_default_params_map]] collects the default values of every parameter required by the [[modeling_tools|ModelingTools]] and by the [[likelihood|TwoPoint]] objects.
These are the cosmological parameters and one linear galaxy bias per lens bin.

```{python}
from firecrown.modeling_tools import ModelingTools
from firecrown.updatable import get_default_params_map

tools = ModelingTools()
params = get_default_params_map(tools, *two_points)

dict(sorted(dict(params).items()))
```

The modeling tools are updated and prepared once.
Each [[likelihood|TwoPoint]] object is then updated and computes its theory vector, the values of $C_\ell$ at the multipoles in `ells`.

```{python}
tools.update(params)
tools.prepare()

theory_vectors = []
for two_point in two_points:
    two_point.update(params)
    theory_vectors.append(two_point.compute_theory_vector(tools))
```

## Plotting the Spectra

The figure has one panel per SACC data type.
Each line is one bin pair, labeled by the index of its first bin and the index of its second bin.
For `galaxy_shearDensity_cl_e` the first bin is the source bin.

```{python}
# | label: fig-3x2pt-cells
# | fig-cap: Angular power spectra of the LSST Y1 3x2pt bin pairs at the default parameter values.
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data_types = ["galaxy_shear_cl_ee", "galaxy_shearDensity_cl_e", "galaxy_density_cl"]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 4.5), constrained_layout=True)
for ax, data_type in zip(axes, data_types):
    for md, cl in zip(metadata, theory_vectors):
        if md.get_sacc_name() != data_type:
            continue
        label = f"({md.XY.x.bin_name[-1]}, {md.XY.y.bin_name[-1]})"
        ax.loglog(md.ells, cl, label=label)
    ax.set_title(data_type)
    ax.set_xlabel(r"$\ell$")
    ax.legend(fontsize="x-small", ncol=2)
axes[0].set_ylabel(r"$C_\ell$")
plt.show()
```
